notes.title: Smash it Wild: A New Game by Goblinz Studio
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

After our trailer debut at the MIX Fall Showcase, we're excited to officially announce Smash It Wild, developed by Goblinz Studio in collaboration with Ernestine! This tactical turn-based game where volleyball and dodgeball meet in a fantasy universe is coming to you in Q2 2025!

[h3][b]Watch the reveal trailer[/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=0bTu4-ZJiSM;full][/previewyoutube]

Dive into a fantasy world where champions face off in an unforgiving tournament. In Smash It Wild, every match counts, mixing volleyball and dodgeball in tactical turn-based gameplay. Upgrade your players, kit them out with powerful items, discover unique synergies and do your best to survive this roguelike competition where defeat means starting all over again.

[h3][b]Features[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Turn-based tactics[/b]: play matches mixing volleyball and dodgeball, where every action can make a difference!

[*][b]Sailpunk universe[/b]: take part in a tournament in a fantasy world filled with animals with a wide variety of abilities.

[*][b]Roguelike progression[/b]: win consecutive matches to find victory. One defeat means starting from scratch!

[*][b]Perfect your strategy[/b]: each team has its own synergies and combos, offering a variety of gameplay styles and strategies to adapt to each match.

[*][b]Create combos[/b]: train your champions, unlock new attacks and equip them with powerful items.

[*][b]Secondary challenges[/b]: complete bonus objectives during matches to gain additional rewards.
[/list]
